from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title, which other provided papers it references, and which provided papers cite it (if mentioned in this document)."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's full title")
    references_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference section")
    cited_by_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper, if this is mentioned in this document's text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
